title: Blind Discovery: Chicane Obstacle Traversal
goal_description: Discover control parameters enabling smooth traversal through chicane obstacles without timeout or collision.

hypotheses.title: Increasing Tangential Gain
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the tangential gain will help the robot navigate the tight turns of the chicane more effectively.
hypotheses.mechanism: By increasing the tangential gain, the robot will be more responsive to the tangential forces, allowing it to make tighter turns without stalling.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Safety Margin
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will encourage the robot to take the turns more closely, potentially improving its ability to navigate the tight turns.
hypotheses.mechanism: By decreasing the safety margin, the robot will have less clearance, forcing it to navigate the turns more precisely.

hypotheses.title: Increasing Repulsion Gain
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will make the robot more aggressive in avoiding obstacles, which could help it navigate the chicane more effectively.
hypotheses.mechanism: By increasing the repulsion gain, the robot will be more sensitive to the presence of obstacles, allowing it to make quicker adjustments to its path.

action_log.message: Formulated 3 competing testable hypotheses grounded in physical dynamics.
